title: DeFiStrategy
description: BibleFi DeFi tithing and giving strategy record. Describes how a church or individual routes and grows digital assets according to biblical stewardship principles.

strategy_id.description: Unique identifier for this DeFi strategy.

schema_version.description: Semantic version of the defi_strategy schema used.

strategy_type.description: Classification of the DeFi strategy type.

church_id.description: Optional reference to the church this strategy is associated with.

wallet_id.description: Optional reference to the wallet record executing this strategy.

target_apy_bps.description: Target annual percentage yield in basis points (1 bps = 0.01%). Max 50000 = 500%.

protocols.description: List of DeFi protocols used in this strategy with allocation weights.

chain_id.description: EIP-155 chain ID where this protocol is deployed.

contract_address.description: EVM contract address of the protocol entry point.

allocation_bps.description: Percentage of strategy assets allocated to this protocol, in basis points.

rebalance_frequency.description: How often the strategy portfolio should be rebalanced.

rebalance_threshold_bps.description: Drift threshold in basis points that triggers a rebalance when rebalance_frequency is 'on_threshold'.

ethical_filters.description: Ethical constraints applied to asset selection in this strategy.

tithe_percentage_bps.description: Percentage of strategy yield automatically directed as tithe, in basis points.

auto_tithe_enabled.description: Whether automatic tithe routing from strategy yield is enabled.

exit_conditions.description: Conditions that trigger an automatic strategy exit to protect capital.

max_drawdown_bps.description: Maximum tolerable drawdown in basis points before exiting.

min_liquidity_usd.description: Minimum USD liquidity in the protocol pool before exiting.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this strategy was created.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the most recent update.
